name: Flat banana
summary: Flat banana: one curved yellow banana or a small bunch of up to three on a shared stem, for fruit scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the item rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: count
params.note: 1 = one banana, 2 or 3 = a small bunch on one stem

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
